GLOBUS_GATEKEEPER_PORT.description: Gatekeeper service port number (IANA registered as gsigatekeeper)

GLOBUS_GATEKEEPER_LOG.description: Path to gatekeeper log file (empty or unset for syslog)

GLOBUS_GATEKEEPER_GRIDMAP.description: Path to X.509 identity to local user mapping file

GLOBUS_GATEKEEPER_CERT_DIR.description: Directory containing trusted X.509 CA certificates

GLOBUS_GATEKEEPER_CERT_FILE.description: Path to service X.509 certificate file

GLOBUS_GATEKEEPER_KEY_FILE.description: Path to service private key file

GLOBUS_GATEKEEPER_KERBEROS_ENABLED.description: Enable Kerberos ticket translation from X.509 credentials

GLOBUS_GATEKEEPER_KMAP.description: Path to globuskmap file (empty uses default if Kerberos enabled)

GLOBUS_GATEKEEPER_PIDFILE.description: Path to PID file for gatekeeper daemon

GLOBUS_GATEKEEPER_NICE_LEVEL.description: Nice level for gatekeeper process priority
